items.explanation: Deep work is defined by sustained, undivided focus on a cognitively demanding task — not by how long it takes or who assigned it.

Deep work

on a cognitively demanding task

Why: This is the kind of work that's hardest to replicate in fragmented time — which is exactly why it's the one most vulnerable to interruptions.
